_comment: Electrical Age configuration in JSON format. Files live in config/eln/.

integrations._comment: Cross-mod integrations and external protocol bridges.

mqtt._comment_enabled: Enable MQTT devices. Server endpoints live in config/eln/mqtt.json.

simMetrics._comment_enabled: Publish simulator MNA metrics to MQTT.
simMetrics._comment_server: MQTT server name in config/eln/mqtt.json used for simulator metrics.
simMetrics._comment_id: Topic ID used under eln/sim/<id>/... for simulator metrics.
simMetrics._comment_publishIntervalTicks: Simulator ticks to aggregate before MQTT publish. Higher values reduce overhead.

computerProbe._comment_enabled: Enable the OC/CC to Eln computer probe.

oredict._comment_tungstenEnabled: Use shared ore dictionary entries for tungsten.
oredict._comment_chipsEnabled: Use shared ore dictionary entries for chips.

logging._comment_simSnapshot: Enable circuit snapshot logging. Requires debug.logging.enabled.

audio._comment_maxSoundDistance: Lower this if you hear clipping in dense generator rooms.
audio._comment_soundChannels: Override the number of sound channels. Use -1 for the Minecraft default.

waila._comment_easyMode: Display more detailed WAILA info on some machines.

icons._comment_noSymbols: Show the item instead of the electrical symbol as an icon.

seasonal._comment_enableFestiveItems: Set false to disable festive items.

crafting._comment_verticalIronCableCrafting: Craft iron cables with vertical ingots instead of horizontal ones.

cables._comment_creativeFreeLength: When enabled, creative players do not consume utility cable length when placing cables or connecting poles.

qol._comment_rememberLastLampSignalName: Lamp sockets remember the last used wireless channel name.
qol._comment_rememberLastLampSocketContents: Lamp sockets are pre filled with last used bulb and cable (creative only).
qol._comment_creativeNoConsumeInsertedItems: Right click insertion does not consume items from creative players.
qol._comment_rememberLastFloodlightBulbs: Floodlights are pre filled with last used bulbs (creative only).

simulation._comment: Electrical, thermal, and room simulation settings.

destruction._comment_thermal: Allow thermal watchdogs to destroy blocks except resistor heat watchdogs.
destruction._comment_resistorHeat: Allow resistor heat watchdogs to destroy blocks.
destruction._comment_current: Allow current watchdogs to destroy blocks.
destruction._comment_voltage: Allow voltage watchdogs to destroy blocks.
destruction._comment_shaftSpeed: Allow shaft speed watchdogs to destroy blocks.
destruction._comment_other: Allow all other watchdog types to destroy blocks.

electrical._comment_frequency: Set to a clean divisor of 20.

cableSpikeLimiter._comment_enabled: Clamp how fast cables and transformers heat up.
cableSpikeLimiter._comment_factor: Multiplier applied to nominal heating rate when the cable spike limiter is enabled.

ambient._comment_lavaRampEnabled: Blend ambient temperature toward 40C between Y20 and Y12, then clamp below Y12.
ambient._comment_undergroundBiomeTemperatureMult: Multiplier applied to biome ambient temperature for the Y50 underground baseline.

roomDetection._comment_maxAxisSpanBlocks: Maximum room span on any axis for room detection.
roomDetection._comment_maxVolumeBlocks: Maximum enclosed-air room volume for room detection.

analytics._comment_playerUuidOptIn: Opt into sending the player UUID with analytics.
analytics._comment_playerUuid: Locally generated UUID used when analytics.playerUuidOptIn is enabled.

world._comment: World interaction toggles and pole placement behavior.

balance._comment: Balance multipliers used across machines and recipes.

integrationConversion._comment_wattsToOc: Watts to OpenComputers power conversion ratio.

autominer._comment_maxRangeBlocks: Maximum horizontal distance from the autominer that will be mined.

heatFurnace._comment_consumeFuel: Controls whether heat furnaces consume fuel.

batteries._comment_standardHalfLifeDays: Number of Minecraft days for a standard battery to decay halfway.

iron._comment_nominalLifeHours: Nominal turbine blade lifetime in hours for the iron tier.
iron._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable wear-out for iron turbine blades.

steel._comment_nominalLifeHours: Nominal turbine blade lifetime in hours for the steel tier.
steel._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable wear-out for steel turbine blades.

alloy._comment_nominalLifeHours: Nominal turbine blade lifetime in hours for the alloy tier.
alloy._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable wear-out for alloy turbine blades.

tungsten._comment_nominalLifeHours: Nominal turbine blade lifetime in hours for the tungsten tier.
tungsten._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable wear-out for tungsten turbine blades.

mobSpawning._comment_preventNearLamps: Prevent monsters from spawning near lamps.

xrayScanner._comment_autoDiscoverOreDictionaryOres: Auto-discover ores from the Ore Dictionary that are not in oreFactors.
xrayScanner._comment_rangeBlocks: X-ray scanner range in blocks. Intended range is 4 to 10.
xrayScanner._comment_autoDiscoveryOreFactor: Default factor for auto-discovered ores not listed in oreFactors.
xrayScanner._comment_oreFactors: Ore scanner detection factors. Keys with ':' are block references (modid:name or modid:name:meta), keys without ':' are OreDictionary names. The ELN ores at the top are, in order: Copper Ore, Lead Ore, Tungsten Ore, and Cinnabar Ore.

transmitter._comment_maxRangeBlocks: Maximum range for wireless transmitters and lamp supplies.

lighting._comment: Lamp technology settings generated from registered lamp types.

incandescent._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable bulb wear-out for incandescent bulbs.

carbon._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable bulb wear-out for carbon bulbs.

fluorescent._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable bulb wear-out for fluorescent bulbs.

farming._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable bulb wear-out for farming bulbs.

led._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable bulb wear-out for led bulbs.

halogen._comment_infiniteLifeEnabled: Disable bulb wear-out for halogen bulbs.
